papers.title: Modelling daily activity patterns from mobile phone location data via deep representation learning
papers.title_zh: 基于手机定位数据的日常活动模式建模：深度表示学习方法
papers.reason: 该文利用手机定位数据通过深度表示学习建模日常活动模式，涉及时空数据挖掘、城市功能上下文与人口统计关联，与研究方向中的时空数据挖掘、多源数据融合及城市分析高度契合。其自监督Transformer建模停留序列的方法对城市更新与人类移动性研究具有直接参考价值。
papers.abstract: Passively collected mobile phone location data provide large-scale, longitudinal observations of human mobility but do not directly reveal activity purposes. The functional characteristics of visited locations offer useful contextual information, yet their relationship with activity purpose remains uncertain, particularly in mixed-use urban environments. We conceptualise activity pattern mining as an integrated process of representation, clustering, and interpretation, and propose the Activity Chain Encoder (ACE) for the representation stage. ACE is a self-supervised model that combines pre-trained urban embeddings with visit timing and duration and uses a Transformer to model the sequential organisation of stays. It is trained using masked activity modelling and identity-guided contrastive learning without requiring deterministic activity purpose labels. Learned daily representations are aggregated into user-level profiles, clustered, and interpreted through temporal-functional patterns and Census-derived demographic context. Applied to mobile phone app location data from London and compared with three representative methods, ACE supports the identification of six differentiated weekday activity-pattern groups characterised by distinct daily rhythms, urban functional contexts, and demographic associations. These complementary forms of evidence further support the development of empirically grounded activity-pattern personas, establishing a holistic route for deriving behaviourally meaningful population patterns from unlabelled mobile phone location data. The source code for the entire analytical pipeline developed in this study is publicly available at https://github.com/xlwang233/ACE.
papers.summary_zh: 被动采集的手机定位数据提供了大规模、纵向的人类移动性观测，但并不直接揭示活动目的。被访问地点的功能特征提供了有用的上下文信息，但其与活动目的的关系仍不确定，尤其在混合用途城市环境中。我们将活动模式挖掘概念化为表示、聚类与解释的集成过程，并提出活动链编码器（ACE）用于表示阶段。ACE是一种自监督模型，结合预训练城市嵌入与访问时间及时长，并使用Transformer建模停留的序列组织。它通过掩码活动建模与身份引导对比学习进行训练，无需确定性的活动目的标签。学习到的日常表示被聚合为用户级画像，进行聚类，并通过时间-功能模式与人口普查派生的人口统计上下文进行解释。应用于伦敦的手机应用定位数据并与三种代表性方法比较，ACE支持识别六个差异化的工作日活动模式组，其特征为不同的日常节律、城市功能上下文与人口统计关联。这些互补形式的证据进一步支持开发基于实证的活动模式人物画像，为从无标签手机定位数据中推导行为上有意义的群体模式建立了整体路径。本研究开发的整个分析流水线源代码公开于https://github.com/xlwang233/ACE。
papers.insight_zh: 该工作表明自监督表示学习可在无活动目的标签下从手机定位数据中提取行为上有意义的日常活动模式，其结合城市功能嵌入与人口统计上下文的思路或可迁移至城市更新中的人口活动与功能演化分析，但摘要未涉及城市更新或遥感数据。

papers.title: DroneGround: Open-Vocabulary Drone Payload Characterization Using Synthetic Data and Grounded Vision-Language Models
papers.title_zh: DroneGround：使用合成数据和接地视觉语言模型进行开放词汇无人机载荷表征
papers.reason: 论文研究无人机载荷的开放词汇表征，利用合成数据和视觉语言模型，处理合成到真实的分布偏移。这与GIS博士研究方向中的遥感变化检测和多源数据融合高度相关，特别是无人机遥感图像分析，具有直接应用价值。
papers.abstract: Automated drone surveillance has become increasingly important for public safety, critical infrastructure protection,and restricted airspace monitoring. While existing vision-based systems achieve strong performance for drone detection and tracking, reliable payload characterization remains highly challenging under long-range imaging conditions due to limited availability of annotated real-world datasets, and substantial distribution shifts encountered during deployment. Existing approaches formulate payload characterization as a closed-set object detection problem, limiting their ability to recognize previously unseen payloads and generalize beyond the training distribution. To address these challenges, we generate a photorealistic synthetic drone-payload dataset using Unreal Engine 5 and Cosys-AirSim and propose DroneGround: Grounded Vision-Language Payload Characterization, a two-stage framework for robust open-vocabulary payload analysis. DroneGround first employs a YOLO26s detector to localize drones and extract drone-centric image crops, followed by a LoRA-fine-tuned PaliGemma vision-language model that generates seman- tic descriptions of the detected drones and their attached payloads, enabling open-vocabulary payload characterization beyond predefined categories. An occlusion-based grounding module further provides interpretable payload localization by identifying image regions responsible for the generated descriptions. Extensive experiments on both synthetic and real-world drone imagery demonstrate that DroneGround substantially improves robustness under synthetic-to-real distribution shifts, outperforming a conventional closed-set payload detector by improving the F1-score from 82.5% to 96.3%, while achieving significantly better generalization to previously unseen payload categories (80.4%versus 42.7% F1). Dataset and code will be released upon acceptance of the paper.
papers.summary_zh: 本文提出DroneGround框架，用于开放词汇的无人机载荷分析。首先用YOLO26s检测器定位无人机，然后用LoRA微调的PaliGemma视觉语言模型生成无人机及其载荷的语义描述，实现超出预定义类别的载荷表征。基于遮挡的接地模块提供可解释的载荷定位。实验表明，DroneGround在合成到真实分布偏移下显著提升鲁棒性，F1分数从82.5%提升到96.3%。
papers.insight_zh: 结合合成数据和接地视觉语言模型可有效提升开放词汇无人机载荷表征在分布偏移下的鲁棒性和泛化能力。

papers.title: SocioVerse2: A Longitudinal Dynamic Social Simulation Framework under a Human-AI Co-evolutionary Paradigm
papers.title_zh: SocioVerse2：人机协同演化范式下的纵向动态社会模拟框架
papers.reason: 该文提出纵向动态社会模拟框架，支持反事实干预与可控研究流程，与LLM和多智能体、时空数据挖掘及城市更新模拟研究高度相关。
papers.abstract: Social simulation offers the social sciences an experimental instrument that the real world cannot supply, and generative agents have transformed it by acting as silicon samples that unite agent-based modeling with real behavioral data. Existing platforms verify collective behavior, align simulated populations with real societies in cross-sections, and employ autonomous agents for the research process. However, two social science requirements remain without systematic support: intervention in the content of a simulation and the researcher's control over the process that produces it. We present SocioVerse2, which extends SocioVerse 1.0 into a human-AI co-evolutionary paradigm built from two loops and one infrastructure. The longitudinal simulation loop simulates the target population with evolving environments and forks counterfactual branches via interventions. The controllable research loop takes the study itself as an editable state and updates state versions via controllable editing. The social science agentic infrastructure carries both loops through composable skills with researcher checkpoints, a population service over five persona pools, and an environment service over 21 real-world signal sources with point-in-time guarantees. We validate SocioVerse2 across three case families and seven case studies, from reproducing canonical agent-based models to modeling policy processes on real records and nowcasting macro-economic indices beyond the response model's knowledge cutoff. With the human-AI co-evolutionary paradigm, these cases go beyond system demonstrations to become substantive studies that investigate frontier questions in their respective disciplines. Code, data services, and a workbench are released as open-source resources.
papers.summary_zh: 社会模拟为社会科学提供了一种现实世界无法提供的实验工具，而生成式智能体通过充当连接基于智能体建模与真实行为数据的“硅样本”改变了这一领域。现有平台验证集体行为、在横截面上使模拟人群与真实社会对齐，并采用自主智能体进行研究过程。然而，社会科学的两项需求仍缺乏系统性支持：对模拟内容的干预以及研究者对产生模拟过程的控制。我们提出SocioVerse2，将SocioVerse 1.0扩展为人机协同演化范式，由两个循环和一个基础设施构成。纵向模拟循环通过演化环境和干预分叉反事实分支来模拟目标人群。可控研究循环将研究本身视为可编辑状态，并通过可控编辑更新状态版本。社会科学智能体基础设施通过带研究者检查点的可组合技能、覆盖五个角色池的人群服务，以及覆盖21个真实世界信号源并具有时点保证的环境服务来承载这两个循环。我们在三个案例族和七个案例研究中验证SocioVerse2，从复现经典基于智能体模型到基于真实记录建模政策过程，再到对超出响应模型知识截止点的宏观经济指标进行临近预测。借助人机协同演化范式，这些案例超越系统演示，成为探究各自学科前沿问题的实质性研究。代码、数据服务和工作台已作为开源资源发布。
papers.insight_zh: 该框架将反事实干预与研究者可控流程结合，为城市更新等社会空间过程的模拟实验提供了可借鉴的人机协同与纵向动态建模范式。

papers.title: High-Dimensional Online Change Point Detection with Adaptive Thresholding and Interpretability
papers.title_zh: 高维在线变化点检测：自适应阈值与可解释性
papers.reason: 高维在线变化点检测与时空数据挖掘、遥感变化检测在方法层面高度相关，其自适应阈值与可解释性框架可迁移至时空序列与遥感时序分析。
papers.abstract: Change point detection (CPD) identifies abrupt and significant changes in sequential data, with applications in human activity recognition, financial markets, cybersecurity, manufacturing, and autonomous systems. Traditional CPD methods often face computational challenges in high-dimensional settings and typically provide limited explanations for detected changes, which can restrict their practical usability. This paper introduces a CPD framework that improves scalability and interpretability by leveraging the Sliced Wasserstein (SW) distance. Our contributions are fourfold: (1) we transform multivariate sequential data into one-dimensional scores using the SW distance, making the resulting representation compatible with existing CPD methods; (2) we analyze the distributional behavior of random slices of the SW distance and show that, under suitable assumptions, they can be approximated by a Gamma distribution, providing a principled basis for threshold calibration; (3) we propose a self-adapting online CPD algorithm that combines this SW-based score with an adaptive quantile-based threshold; (4) we introduce a model-specific framework for generating contrastive explanations for annotated change points. Empirically, our method reduces false positives by at least $48\%$ on average compared with popular online and offline CPD baselines, while maintaining competitive or superior detection performance. Code is available at https://github.com/jsve96/SWCPD_Code. At the same time, it produces interpretable change-point annotations, making it practical for deployment in high-stakes applications.
papers.summary_zh: 变化点检测（CPD）用于识别序列数据中的突变，应用于人类活动识别、金融市场、网络安全、制造与自主系统。传统方法在高维场景下计算困难且解释性有限。本文提出基于Sliced Wasserstein（SW）距离的CPD框架，贡献包括：(1) 用SW距离将多变量序列转为一维得分，兼容现有CPD方法；(2) 分析SW随机切片的分布行为，在适当假设下可用Gamma分布近似，为阈值标定提供依据；(3) 提出结合SW得分与自适应分位数阈值的自适在线CPD算法；(4) 提出针对标注变化点的对比解释生成框架。实验显示，相比主流在线与离线基线，该方法平均减少至少48%的误报，同时保持相当或更优的检测性能，并产生可解释的变化点标注。
papers.insight_zh: 该框架的SW降维+自适应分位数阈值思路可迁移到城市时空监测与遥感时序变化检测中，用于降低高维误报；其对比解释机制也有助于变化检测结果的可解释呈现，但摘要未验证地理空间数据。

papers.title: From UNDRR Reports to Event Records: Schema-Constrained LLM Extraction of Georeferenced Disasters
papers.title_zh: 从UNDRR报告到事件记录：地理参考灾害的模式约束LLM抽取
papers.reason: 该文利用LLM从UNDRR报告中抽取地理参考灾害事件记录，涉及地理编码、模式约束抽取和地理空间数据构建，与地理空间智能和多源数据融合高度相关，且灾害事件时空数据挖掘与城市更新研究中的时空数据挖掘方法论相通。
papers.abstract: Disaster-risk-reduction archives describe hazard events in prose that databases such as EM-DAT (Delforge et al., 2025) cannot ingest directly. We present an LLM pipeline that generates candidate georeferenced event records using a controlled hazard vocabulary and fixed schema, retaining evidence for review. Applied to 10,000 documents from PreventionWeb, the knowledge hub managed by UNDRR, it produced 3,572 records from 1,913 documents across 24 hazard types and resolved 81% of location mentions to OpenStreetMap geometries. On 171 human-positive document windows from a stratified 217-document reference set, GPT-5 achieved 86.0% pooled attribute $F_1$, versus 44.2% for the spaCy-gazetteer baseline. Evaluation pools hazard families, location strings, and event years within documents, without assessing their assignment to individual events. GPT-5.4 ranked highest among ten LLMs (86.6% $F_1$). Verbatim evidence occurrence was 72.0% for GPT-5 and 47.2% for GPT-5.4, measuring textual traceability without establishing attribute support. We report production failure modes and automated label and location-rule compliance checks. Prompts, schema, and outputs will be released for adaptation to national reporting archives.
papers.summary_zh: 灾害风险减少档案以散文形式描述灾害事件，EM-DAT等数据库无法直接摄取。本文提出一个LLM流程，使用受控灾害词汇表和固定模式生成候选地理参考事件记录，并保留证据以供审查。应用于UNDRR管理的知识中心PreventionWeb的10,000份文档，从1,913份文档中生成3,572条记录，涵盖24种灾害类型，并将81%的位置提及解析为OpenStreetMap几何。在分层217份文档参考集中171个人工正例文档窗口上，GPT-5达到86.0%的汇总属性F_1，而spaCy-gazetteer基线为44.2%。评估在文档内汇总灾害家族、位置字符串和事件年份，未评估其到单个事件的分配。GPT-5.4在十个LLM中排名最高（86.6% F_1）。GPT-5的逐字证据出现率为72.0%，GPT-5.4为47.2%，衡量文本可追溯性但未确立属性支持。报告了生产故障模式及自动化标签和位置规则合规检查。提示、模式及输出将发布以供适配国家报告档案。
papers.insight_zh: 该文的模式约束LLM抽取+地理编码流程可直接启发城市更新研究中从政策文本或规划报告中抽取地理参考事件记录；其证据保留和合规检查机制对构建可审查的时空知识库具有参考价值，但需注意其评估未涉及事件级分配精度。

papers.title: Toollery: Scaling LLM Agents to Thousands of Skills and Tools
papers.title_zh: Toollery：将LLM智能体扩展至数千种技能与工具
papers.reason: 该论文研究LLM智能体在数千种技能与工具规模下的扩展问题，与用户研究兴趣中“LLM和多智能体”方向高度契合，但其应用场景并非地理空间领域，因此相关性较高但非完全匹配。
papers.abstract: As LLM agents are exposed to hundreds to tens of thousands of skills, tools, and API functions, full-library prompting becomes costly, slow, and less reliable: each added candidate increases prompt tokens and latency, while longer candidate lists introduce more distractors for LLM selection. We present ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
papers.summary_zh: 随着LLM智能体面对数百至数万种技能、工具和API函数，全库提示变得昂贵、缓慢且可靠性下降：每增加一个候选项都会增加提示词元数和延迟，更长的候选列表也会引入更多干扰项。本文提出了Toollery（摘要在此处截断，未提供完整方法细节）。
papers.insight_zh: 该工作聚焦于LLM智能体在工具规模扩展时的效率与选择可靠性问题，其思路可能为地理空间智能中多工具协同的智能体系统提供参考，但摘要未给出具体方法或实验结论，无法进一步推断其在地理空间领域的适用性。

papers.title: LE4Mob: Towards Inductive, Distance-Aware and General-Purpose Location Embedding for Human Mobility Modelling
papers.title_zh: LE4Mob：面向人类移动性建模的归纳式、距离感知与通用位置嵌入
papers.reason: 该论文提出归纳式、距离感知、通用位置嵌入框架LE4Mob用于人类移动性建模，直接涉及时空数据挖掘、位置表示学习与地理空间智能，与研究方向高度契合，尤其与时空数据挖掘和多源数据融合相关。
papers.abstract: Location representations provide mobility models with fundamental information about the spatial position, functional characteristics, and relationships of places. However, existing embeddings are often dependent on mobility observations, unable to represent unseen locations, and weakly constrained to retain geographic distance. This limits their reuse across datasets and mobility tasks. To address these limitations, we propose LE4Mob, an inductive, distance-aware, and geography-derived location embedding framework for mobility modelling. LE4Mob extends contrastive language-location pre-training while introducing a distance-aware regularisation objective that encourages the embedding space to preserve spatial relationships. Pre-trained from geographic context, LE4Mob can encode rich spatial-semantic information and generate embeddings for unseen locations inductively. Its independence from downstream mobility task supervision also makes it transferable across different mobility tasks. We evaluate LE4Mob on individual-level next location prediction and population-level commuter flow generation. Experiments across multiple datasets and study areas show that LE4Mob outperforms strong baselines, with particular advantages in inductive settings and when downstream models rely directly on interactions between location embeddings. These findings demonstrate the potential of distance-aware, geography-derived location representations as reusable foundations for human mobility modelling.
papers.summary_zh: 位置表示为移动性模型提供关于地点空间位置、功能特征和关系的基础信息。然而，现有嵌入往往依赖移动性观测，无法表示未见位置，且对保留地理距离的约束较弱，限制了其跨数据集和跨移动性任务的复用。为解决这些局限，作者提出LE4Mob，一种面向移动性建模的归纳式、距离感知且由地理信息导出的位置嵌入框架。LE4Mob扩展了对比式语言—位置预训练，同时引入距离感知正则化目标，促使嵌入空间保留空间关系。由于从地理语境预训练，LE4Mob能编码丰富的空间语义信息，并归纳式地为未见位置生成嵌入；其独立于下游移动性任务监督，也使其可跨不同移动性任务迁移。作者在个体级下一位置预测和群体级通勤流生成上评估LE4Mob。跨多个数据集和研究区域的实验表明，LE4Mob优于强基线，在归纳式设置以及下游模型直接依赖位置嵌入间交互时优势尤为明显。
papers.insight_zh: 该工作表明，将地理语境与距离感知正则化结合，可产生可复用、可归纳的位置表示，缓解传统嵌入对观测数据的依赖；这一思路对城市更新中的地点功能表征和跨城市迁移建模具有潜在价值，但其在细粒度城市更新场景下的适用性尚待验证。

papers.title: SCoNE: Selective Context-aware Neuron Editing for Robust Retrieval-Augmented Generation
papers.title_zh: SCoNE：用于鲁棒检索增强生成的选择性上下文感知神经元编辑
papers.reason: 针对RAG中检索噪声导致幻觉的问题，提出无需训练的模型编辑方法。这与利用LLM和多智能体进行地理空间文本挖掘、知识问答等场景高度相关，直接关系到系统的鲁棒性和可靠性。
papers.abstract: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) is highly sensitive to retrieval noise: when retrieved documents mix informative and irrelevant context, LLMs are easily distracted, leading to hallucinations. To overcome this, we propose SCoNE (Selective Context-aware Neuron Editing), a training-free model editing approach that improves retrieval noise robustness by selectively strengthening context-aware FFN neurons that are identified by both high attribution and high cross-input variability. SCoNE requires only a small number of mining samples, no fine-tuning, and no inference-time overhead. Across various knowledge-intensive question-answering benchmarks and two LLM backbones, SCoNE consistently outperforms competitive baseline methods. Our code is available at https://github.com/HYU-ARK-Lab/SCoNE.
papers.summary_zh: 提出SCoNE，一种无需训练的模型编辑方法，通过选择性地增强具有高归因和高跨输入变异性的上下文感知FFN神经元，来提高LLM对检索噪声的鲁棒性。该方法仅需少量挖掘样本，无需微调，且无推理时开销，在多个知识密集型问答基准和两个LLM骨干上优于基线方法。
papers.insight_zh: 该研究提供了一种轻量级、即插即用的手段来缓解RAG系统中的噪声干扰问题，对于构建基于海量、异构且可能含噪的地理文本数据的知识问答或决策支持智能体具有直接的应用潜力。

papers.title: RS-Claw-Evolution: Environment-Feedback-Driven Evolution for Lightweight Remote Sensing Agents in Long-Horizon Tasks
papers.reason: 关键词命中：Geospatial、Remote Sensing、Large Language Model
papers.abstract: Large language model-driven remote sensing (RS) agents offer a promising approach to automating geospatial analysis. However, lightweight RS agents based on compact language models struggle with multi-step interactive tasks due to loss of long-horizon states, inefficient environmental feedback utilization, and sparse optimization signals. We propose RS-Claw-Evolution, an environment-feedback-driven framework that progressively improves lightweight agents through three stages. Interaction evolution uses executable code to control observations, maintain intermediate states, and reduce context redundancy. Experience evolution combines failure-aware trajectory generation with error-turn masking to learn from informative failure-recovery experiences without imitating faulty actions. Decision evolution uses reinforcement learning with multi-dimensional environment rewards and turn-level advantage protection to optimize tool-use behaviors and improve credit assignment in long sequences. On Earth-Bench, the optimized Qwen3-4B-based agent achieves 65.9% accuracy in Autonomous Planning mode, outperforming the untrained Qwen3-32B baseline (43.8%) and DeepSeek-V3.1 (60.8%), while approaching GPT-5 (71.6%). These results demonstrate that learning from environmental feedback can improve lightweight agents and narrow their performance gap with larger models in long-horizon RS tasks.

papers.title: UniGIO: Unified Generative Global In-situ Weather Modeling from Spatiotemporal Incomplete Observations
papers.title_zh: UniGIO：面向时空不完整观测的统一生成式全球原位气象建模
papers.reason: 该论文处理全球原位气象观测的时空不完整性问题，提出生成式框架统一预测、插补与生成任务，与用户研究兴趣中的“时空数据挖掘”和“多源数据融合”方向相关，但应用领域为气象而非城市更新或遥感变化检测。
papers.abstract: Global In-situ Observation (GIO) provides fine-scale, direct records of the global weather system from sparse point stations, making it an indispensable source for capturing localized and transient dynamics beyond the reach of satellite gridded data, and playing a critical role in key fields such as numerical weather prediction, disaster prevention, and agriculture. However, GIO exhibits strong spatiotemporal incompleteness, severely impairing accurate and real-time in-situ weather modeling. Unlike existing methods waiting for completed AI-ready data with extra introduced errors, in this work, we explore UniGIO, a novel generative framework for directly modeling global in-situ weather dynamics from native incomplete GIO. By generating missing data from observed ones annotated by masks, it unifies the coexisting forecasting, imputation, and generation under arbitrary missing ratios. Between the missing and observed, UniGIO captures station and region level complementarity through the Observation Mixer and Event Aligner, which diffuse discrete observations into continuous spaces where weather processes naturally span multiple stations. We further establish temporal dependencies with pattern shifts using the Adaptive Temporal Mixer, and track extreme events in chaotic local weather systems through a Mixture-ofExperts structure. Steady and extreme events are adapted in decoder by a Local Refiner. Extensive experiments on the up-todate largest global station weather dataset Weather-5K validate its SOTA performance with 11%, 12%, and 5% advantages on accuracy, fidelity, and extreme event capture, delivering a novel holistic solution for weather modeling in GIO networks.
papers.summary_zh: 全球原位观测（GIO）通过稀疏站点提供全球天气系统的精细直接记录，是捕捉卫星网格数据无法覆盖的局地和瞬态动态不可或缺的来源。然而GIO存在强烈的时空不完整性，严重损害了准确实时的原位气象建模。本文提出UniGIO，一种新颖的生成式框架，可直接从原生不完整GIO建模全球原位天气动态。通过从带掩码标注的观测数据生成缺失数据，UniGIO统一了任意缺失比例下并存的预测、插补和生成任务。UniGIO通过Observation Mixer和Event Aligner在缺失与观测之间捕捉站点和区域级别的互补性，将离散观测扩散到连续空间；通过Adaptive Temporal Mixer建立时间依赖性与模式偏移；通过Mixture-of-Experts结构追踪混沌局地天气系统中的极端事件。在迄今最大的全球站点天气数据集Weather-5K上的大量实验验证了其SOTA性能，在准确性、保真度和极端事件捕捉方面分别有11%、12%和5%的优势。
papers.insight_zh: 该工作展示了生成式框架在处理时空不完整观测数据方面的潜力，其统一预测、插补与生成的思路可能对城市时空数据挖掘中普遍存在的数据缺失问题具有方法借鉴意义，但摘要未涉及城市更新或遥感变化检测场景。

papers.title: PACE: A Unified Condense-and-Extract Paradigm for Fast VLM Inference
papers.title_zh: PACE：用于快速VLM推理的统一压缩-提取范式
papers.reason: 该研究针对视觉语言模型推理成本高的问题，提出了一种无需训练的推理加速框架，同时优化视觉编码器和LLM阶段。对于处理大规模遥感影像或视频数据的地理空间智能应用，高效的视觉推理方法具有重要参考价值。
papers.summary_zh: PACE是一个无需训练的推理框架，通过统一的Condense-and-Extract范式加速视觉编码器和LLM。在Condense阶段，自适应像素压缩器在编码前评估视觉信息密度，自适应下采样冗余输入。在Extract阶段，动态双注意力提取器通过融合编码器的内部视觉信号和LLM的语义信号选择性保留视觉token。集成到Qwen2.5-VL-7B后，仅使用10%的视觉token即可保留93.8%的性能，实现3.1倍的TTFT加速。
papers.insight_zh: 该研究提出在视觉编码前进行信息密度评估和自适应压缩，挑战了视觉token必须全部编码的传统假设，为高分辨率遥感影像的实时视觉语言理解提供了新的效率优化方向。

papers.title: PanoSeg3R: Feed-Forward 3D Semantic Segmentation for Panoramic Images with an Automatic Data Curation Pipeline
papers.title_zh: PanoSeg3R：面向全景图像的前馈三维语义分割与自动数据策展流程
papers.reason: 该文提出全景图像的前馈三维语义分割框架与自动数据策展流程，涉及三维场景理解、伪标签生成与零样本泛化，与遥感变化检测、多源数据融合及地理空间智能有较强方法关联。
papers.abstract: We present PanoSeg3R, a feed-forward framework for 3D panoramic semantic segmentation. Unlike existing methods designed for perspective inputs, PanoSeg3R jointly predicts 3D geometry and multi-view semantic segmentation in one single forward pass. Built upon a pretrained reconstruction backbone that supports panoramic images, our approach extends feed-forward 3D reconstruction with a query-based mask decoder. Furthermore, we introduce an automatic panorama data curation pipeline that leverages the complementary strengths of off-the-shelf foundation models to generate reliable pseudo semantic annotations, substantially expanding the training data and improving zero-shot generalization. PanoSeg3R achieves state-of-the-art performance on panoramic 3D semantic segmentation, improving 3D mIoU by up to 16.02 on ScanNet++, while the curated training data further improves zero-shot performance by up to 4.26 and 43.28 mIoU on Stanford2D3D and ToF-360, respectively. Website: https://harryyoon777.github.io/PanoSeg3R/
papers.summary_zh: 本文提出PanoSeg3R，一种用于三维全景语义分割的前馈框架。与面向透视输入设计的现有方法不同，PanoSeg3R在单次前向传播中联合预测三维几何与多视角语义分割。该方法建立在支持全景图像的预训练重建骨干之上，通过基于查询的掩码解码器扩展前馈三维重建。此外，作者引入自动全景数据策展流程，利用现成基础模型的互补优势生成可靠的伪语义标注，大幅扩展训练数据并提升零样本泛化能力。PanoSeg3R在全景三维语义分割上达到最先进性能，在ScanNet++上三维mIoU最多提升16.02，而策展训练数据进一步在Stanford2D3D和ToF-360上分别将零样本性能提升最多4.26和43.28 mIoU。
papers.insight_zh: 该文利用基础模型生成伪标注以扩展训练数据的策略，对遥感与地理空间领域中标注稀缺场景下的数据增强与零样本迁移具有参考价值。

papers.title: WildfireSpreadBench: The Metric Decides the Model in Wildfire Spread Prediction
papers.title_zh: WildfireSpreadBench：在野火蔓延预测中指标决定模型
papers.reason: 该文研究野火蔓延预测的评估指标问题，属于遥感与地理空间机器学习应用，与遥感变化检测和地理空间智能方向较为相关，但其重点在评估指标而非变化检测方法本身。
papers.abstract: Machine learning is being increasingly used to predict where active wildfires will burn the following day, helping inform evacuation boundaries and containment lines. Most models are evaluated using Average Precision (AP), which summarizes performance across all decision thresholds, although acting on a forecast requires choosing one. We benchmarked five discriminative architectures and one generative model on WildfireSpreadTS using a shared evaluation pipeline and two input configurations. We found that model rankings varied depending on whether performance was measured by AP or by threshold-dependent metrics like F1 and IoU. The highest-AP model flagged 4 to 5 times the area that burned and ranked fifth of six on F1 and IoU, and the most recall-heavy model flagged 16 to 23 times. Models with more usable predictions had AP scores 24 to 37 lower. Across architectures, we identified three distinct prediction profiles: over-predicting, balanced, and under-predicting, which AP alone could not distinguish. Expanding the input from 7 to 23 channels changed AP by 0.03 on average, against a 0.21 to 0.24 spread across architectures. These results show AP alone can favor models whose predictions are poorly suited for operational wildfire forecasting.
papers.summary_zh: 机器学习正越来越多地用于预测活跃野火次日将燃烧的位置，以帮助确定疏散边界和隔离线。大多数模型使用平均精度（AP）评估，它汇总了所有决策阈值下的性能，而根据预报采取行动则需要选择一个阈值。作者在WildfireSpreadTS上使用共享评估流水线和两种输入配置，对五种判别式架构和一种生成模型进行基准测试。他们发现，模型排名会因使用AP还是使用F1和IoU等阈值依赖指标而不同。AP最高的模型标记的面积是实际燃烧面积的4至5倍，在F1和IoU上排名六者中的第五；而召回率最高的模型标记面积达16至23倍。预测更可用的模型AP分数低24至37。跨架构，作者识别出三种不同的预测特征：过度预测、平衡和预测不足，仅靠AP无法区分。将输入从7个通道扩展到23个通道使AP平均变化0.03，而架构间的差异为0.21至0.24。这些结果表明，仅用AP可能偏向那些预测不适合实际野火预报的模型。
papers.insight_zh: 该研究警示，在遥感变化检测与地理空间预测任务中，评估指标的选择可能显著影响模型排名与业务适用性，提示研究者在城市变化检测等任务中应结合阈值依赖指标进行综合评估。

papers.title: BackTrend: Evaluating Scientific Weak-Signal Prediction via Backward Reconstruction
papers.title_zh: BackTrend：通过反向重建评估科学弱信号预测
papers.reason: 该文构建了科学弱信号预测的回顾性基准，评估LLM、RAG与智能体研究系统，与时空数据挖掘中的趋势识别和LLM/多智能体研究兴趣相关，但未涉及地理空间数据或城市更新。
papers.abstract: Scientific weak signals are early, low-visibility research directions that later become central to mature scientific topics, yet existing resources such as trend tracking, citation forecasting, and foresight reports rarely provide validated reference sets that link concrete early precursors to later paradigms. We introduce BackTrend, a retrospective benchmark in which, given a mature target topic and a temporal evidence constraint, systems must recover two types of precursors: problem-space signals, underrecognized research problems, and solution-space signals, emerging methods for known problems. BackTrend contains 25 mature target topics in artificial intelligence and machine learning and 66 human-validated weak signals, reconstructed from large-scale literature by grounding each candidate in its 2019-2024 publication-frequency trajectory. We evaluate frontier LLMs, RAG systems, and agentic research systems using semantic matching and coverage-based metrics. Current systems often generate plausible but misaligned precursors, exhibiting topic drift, granularity mismatch, near-miss matching, and incomplete coverage; the strongest system achieves only 10.1% F1, while Coverage10 reaches at most 18.5% of the reference signals. Our budget analyses show that additional retrieval and web-search evidence can improve performance up to a moderate budget, but does not by itself close the substantial performance gap.
papers.summary_zh: 科学弱信号是早期、低可见度但后来成为成熟科学主题核心的研究方向，然而趋势追踪、引用预测和前瞻报告等现有资源很少提供将具体早期前兆与后期范式联系起来的经过验证的参考集。我们提出BackTrend，一个回顾性基准：给定一个成熟目标主题和时间证据约束，系统必须恢复两类前兆——问题空间信号（未被充分认识的研究问题）和解决方案空间信号（针对已知问题的新兴方法）。BackTrend包含人工智能和机器学习领域的25个成熟目标主题和66个经人工验证的弱信号，通过将每个候选信号锚定在其2019—2024年发表频率轨迹上，从大规模文献中重建。我们使用语义匹配和基于覆盖率的指标评估前沿LLM、RAG系统和智能体研究系统。当前系统往往生成看似合理但错位的前兆，表现出主题漂移、粒度不匹配、近似匹配和不完整覆盖；最强系统仅达到10.1%的F1，Coverage10最多达到参考信号的18.5%。我们的预算分析表明，额外的检索和网络搜索证据可在中等预算内提升性能，但本身无法弥合巨大的性能差距。
papers.insight_zh: 该基准揭示了当前LLM与智能体系统在识别科学弱信号方面仍存在显著不足，提示在时空数据挖掘与文献趋势分析中，单纯增加检索预算不足以解决语义错位与覆盖不全问题。

papers.title: TimeLitmus: A Diagnostic Benchmark for Cross-Modal Understanding and Explanation Faithfulness in Event-Conditioned Time-Series Prediction
papers.title_zh: TimeLitmus：事件条件下时间序列预测中跨模态理解与解释忠实性的诊断基准
papers.reason: 该论文关注LLM在事件条件下的时间序列预测中的跨模态理解与解释忠实性，与研究中LLM、时空数据挖掘及多智能体方向有一定关联，但未涉及城市更新或遥感变化检测。
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used to make predictions from numerical time-series histories and textual events. Yet accuracy alone cannot reveal whether correct answers reflect effective integration of the two inputs or instead arise from event polarity, unimodal priors, or superficial cues. Likewise, plausible explanations may rationalize predictions without faithfully reflecting the evidence that drives model behavior. We introduce TimeLitmus, a diagnostic benchmark for cross-modal understanding and explanation faithfulness in event-conditioned time-series prediction. TimeLitmus contains 4,856 evaluation records across Finance and Traffic, combining natural prediction with controlled counterfactual and contrastive interventions, explanation-targeted faithfulness tests, and systematic shortcut controls. Across ten representative LLMs, standard prediction accuracy substantially overstates reliable cross-modal understanding: Hard Paired Contrast (HPC) pair correctness peaks at only 19.2% in Finance and 11.7% in Traffic, and all ten models show lower-than-expected consistency on Finance series-side controls. Models often recognize scenario relations explicitly yet fail to apply them during independent prediction. Explanation faithfulness shows a similar gap: in Traffic, most models cite the manipulated temporal factor in over 90% of cases, while behavioral support remains below 22%. Human annotators outperform LLMs on matched controlled and hard-pair diagnostics, confirming that these distinctions are recoverable from the inputs. Natural-only adaptation yields selective gains in evidence selection and input sensitivity, but not consistent gains in controlled or hard-pair behavior. The benchmark, evaluation suite, and supervised adaptation data will be released publicly.
papers.summary_zh: 大语言模型（LLM）越来越多地被用于从数值时间序列历史和文本事件中进行预测。然而，仅凭准确率无法揭示正确答案是源于对两种输入的有效整合，还是来自事件极性、单模态先验或表面线索。同样，看似合理的解释可能只是为预测提供合理化说辞，而并未忠实反映驱动模型行为的证据。我们提出TimeLitmus，一个用于事件条件下时间序列预测中跨模态理解与解释忠实性的诊断基准。TimeLitmus包含金融和交通领域的4,856条评估记录，结合了自然预测与受控反事实和对比干预、面向解释的忠实性测试以及系统性捷径控制。在十个代表性LLM上，标准预测准确率大幅高估了可靠的跨模态理解：困难配对对比（HPC）配对正确率在金融领域最高仅为19.2%，在交通领域为11.7%，且十个模型在金融序列侧控制上均表现出低于预期的一致性。模型往往能明确识别场景关系，却在独立预测时无法应用这些关系。解释忠实性也呈现类似差距：在交通领域，大多数模型在超过90%的情况下引用了被操纵的时间因素，而行为支持率仍低于22%。人类标注者在匹配的受控和困难配对诊断上优于LLM，证实这些区分可从输入中恢复。仅自然数据的适配在证据选择和输入敏感性方面带来选择性提升，但在受控或困难配对行为上没有一致增益。该基准、评估套件和监督适配数据将被发布。
papers.insight_zh: 该基准揭示了LLM在事件条件下时间序列预测中准确率与真实跨模态理解之间的显著差距，提示在时空数据挖掘中应用LLM时需警惕表面线索和解释不忠实问题。

papers.title: Dynamic Thermal Gaussians: Multimodal 4D Gaussian Splatting
papers.title_zh: 动态热高斯：多模态4D高斯泼溅
papers.reason: 该文提出动态RGB-热红外4D高斯泼溅重建框架，将颜色与热模态锚定到共享几何基底并建模时空形变，与多源数据融合和遥感变化检测中的时空建模思路相关，但应用场景为通用复杂场景而非城市/遥感，故相关性中等。
papers.abstract: Thermography plays a vital role in military and broader thermal analysis applications. Recent progress in 3D thermal reconstruction has extended temperature analysis from 2D to 3D space, yet most existing works assume static temperature distributions, neglecting the temporal dynamics of heat transfer in real-world environments. To address this limitation, we propose the first dynamic RGB-Thermal reconstruction framework for complex scenes. Our method jointly models RGB appearance, thermal observations, and scene geometry as they change over time. Specifically, we introduce a multimodal dynamic scene representation that anchors both the color and thermal modalities to a shared geometric substrate, ensuring their consistency under spatiotemporal deformations. We further design multimodal embeddings to enhance the motion expressiveness for each modality, and propose a multimodal routing mechanism that retains a unified set of shared multimodal Gaussians as the geometric backbone while adaptively spawning modality-specific Gaussians to strengthen the representational capacity in detail-rich regions of each individual modality. In addition, we contribute a novel benchmark dataset featuring high-frequency temperature variations to facilitate the evaluation of 4D reconstruction. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our method achieves high-fidelity spatiotemporal reconstruction of both appearance and temperature. Our code and dataset are available at: https://github.com/LinLif1869/DTG.
papers.summary_zh: 热成像在军事及更广泛的热分析应用中至关重要。近期三维热重建的进展将温度分析从二维扩展到三维空间，但多数现有工作假设温度分布是静态的，忽略了真实环境中热传递的时间动态。为解决这一局限，作者提出首个面向复杂场景的动态RGB-热红外重建框架。该方法联合建模随时间变化的RGB外观、热观测与场景几何。具体而言，作者引入多模态动态场景表示，将颜色与热模态锚定到共享几何基底，确保其在时空形变下的一致性；进一步设计多模态嵌入以增强各模态的运动表达能力，并提出多模态路由机制，在保留统一共享多模态高斯作为几何主干的同时，自适应生成模态特定的高斯以增强各模态细节丰富区域的表示能力。此外，作者贡献了一个具有高频温度变化的新基准数据集以支持4D重建评估。大量实验表明该方法实现了外观与温度的高保真时空重建。代码与数据集已公开。
papers.insight_zh: 共享几何基底加模态特定高斯的表示思路，可能为多源遥感数据（如光学与热红外）的时空一致性融合提供借鉴；其高频温度变化基准也提示热动态建模需要专门的时序数据支撑。

papers.title: EDGEGEN: Improving Tool-Calling Agents Beyond Happy Paths with Synthetic Edge Case Generation
papers.title_zh: EDGEGEN：利用合成边缘案例生成改进超越顺利路径的工具调用智能体
papers.reason: 该文研究工具调用LLM智能体的合成边缘案例生成与自动化闭环优化，与研究中LLM和多智能体方向直接相关，但未涉及地理空间或城市更新应用。
papers.abstract: Tool-calling LLM agents are increasingly deployed in enterprise applications. However, effective evaluation and optimization require high-quality, diverse task datasets that are often difficult to obtain due to privacy and other constraints. Existing synthetic task generation methods often produce generic tasks that ignore an agent's underlying state or database and fail to reflect real-world usage diversity. We propose EdgeGen, a synthetic task generation framework that extracts compliance rules from an agent's specification and uses them to generate database-grounded edge-case tasks designed to violate these rules. When combined with existing synthetic data generation techniques, EdgeGen enables agent improvement through finetuning and harness optimization. The resulting pipeline forms a fully automated closed-loop system that requires no human annotation. Finetuning on data generated by EdgeGen yields a consistent mean progress improvement of 2 percent to 42 percent on tau2bench airline domain, while other baseline methods show degradation for some models. On the other hand, for harness optimization, our method shows a mean progress improvement of 10 percent and 30 percent over the human-curated and base harnesses, respectively, for the Gemma-4-e4b model.
papers.summary_zh: 工具调用型LLM智能体正越来越多地部署于企业应用中，但高质量、多样化的任务数据集因隐私等限制往往难以获取。现有合成任务生成方法常产生通用任务，忽视智能体的底层状态或数据库，且无法反映真实使用多样性。作者提出EdgeGen，一种合成任务生成框架，从智能体规范中提取合规规则，并据此生成旨在违反这些规则的、基于数据库的边缘案例任务。与现有合成数据生成技术结合后，EdgeGen可通过微调和框架优化实现智能体改进，形成无需人工标注的全自动闭环系统。在tau2bench航空领域，基于EdgeGen生成数据的微调带来2%至42%的平均进度提升，而其他基线方法在某些模型上出现性能退化；在框架优化方面，该方法相较人工整理和基础框架分别取得10%和30%的平均进度提升（Gemma-4-e4b模型）。
papers.insight_zh: 该工作提示：面向智能体的合成数据若能从规范中抽取约束并定向生成违规边缘案例，可在无人工标注下形成闭环优化；这一思路或可迁移至地理空间智能体的任务评测与鲁棒性提升，但文中未涉及地理场景。

papers.title: ACLArena: Agent Continue Learning in Multi-stage Post-training
papers.title_zh: ACLArena：多阶段后训练中的智能体持续学习
papers.reason: 该论文研究智能体持续学习（ACL）与多阶段后训练，涉及多教师蒸馏、LoRA专家路由等，与研究中LLM和多智能体方向相关，但未涉及地理空间或城市更新应用。
papers.abstract: Building general-purpose agents for industrial deployment requires integrating multiple capabilities, each typically acquired at a distinct stage of training. Yet there is currently no well-established recipe for Agent Continual Learning (ACL), with little understanding of the trade-offs among existing integration paradigms. To address this gap, we introduce ACLArena, a framework for comprehensively studying, analyzing, and evaluating ACL. We first build a sequential training pipeline and conduct an in-depth analysis that explains the mechanisms of forgetting and generalization from two complementary perspectives, the model level and the token level. Guided by these analyses, we systematically compare multi-teacher on-policy distillation, self-distilled fine-tuning, and model merging to assess their ability to recover previously learned capabilities while preserving newly acquired ones. Through extensive experiments, we develop a detailed understanding of how capabilities transfer across stages. Finally, we propose a new ACL recipe that combines offline replay over high-quality trajectories with a routed network of multiple LoRA experts each specialized via RL, substantially improving the agent's ability to learn across multiple domains. Comprehensive experiments on four reasoning and agentic tasks, evaluated under both in-domain and out-of-domain settings, demonstrate the value of our analysis and the effectiveness of our approach.
papers.summary_zh: 构建通用工业部署智能体需要整合多种能力，而这些能力通常在不同训练阶段获得。然而目前尚无成熟的智能体持续学习（ACL）方案，对现有整合范式之间的权衡也缺乏理解。为填补这一空白，作者提出ACLArena框架，用于全面研究、分析和评估ACL。他们首先构建顺序训练流水线，并从模型层面和token层面两个互补视角深入分析遗忘与泛化的机制。在这些分析指导下，系统比较了多教师在线策略蒸馏、自蒸馏微调和模型合并三种方法在恢复旧能力同时保持新能力方面的表现。通过大量实验，深入理解了能力如何跨阶段迁移。最后提出一种新的ACL方案，结合高质量轨迹的离线回放与多个经RL专门化的LoRA专家路由网络，显著提升智能体跨多领域学习能力。在四个推理和智能体任务上的域内和域外综合实验验证了分析的价值和方法的有效性。
papers.insight_zh: 该工作为智能体持续学习提供了系统性的分析框架和评估基准，其多LoRA专家路由与离线回放结合的方案可能为多智能体系统中能力整合提供参考，但需注意其应用场景为通用推理与智能体任务，未涉及地理空间领域。

papers.title: MotionJEPA: Preventing Temporal Feature Collapse by Capturing Visual Changes in Latent Space
papers.title_zh: MotionJEPA：通过在潜在空间中捕捉视觉变化防止时序特征坍缩
papers.reason: 该文提出MotionJEPA，通过差异图像与单图像嵌入正则化防止时序特征坍缩，核心在于潜在空间中捕捉视觉变化，与遥感变化检测和时空数据挖掘在方法论上高度相关，但未涉及地理空间数据或城市应用。
papers.abstract: Joint Embedding Predictive Architectures (JEPAs) are a promising paradigm for learning task-agnostic latent world models without visual reconstruction. However, standard JEPA training exhibits a strong inductive bias towards slow features, causing feature suppression and the collapse of latent representation. While inverse dynamics provides temporal anti-collapse, it relies on action labels and offers little incentive to embed general, unlabeled dynamics. We introduce Difference Image and Single image embedding Regularization (DISReg), a novel regularizer that builds on an inverse-dynamics-style module that predicts temporal difference image embeddings without any pixel reconstruction loss, encouraging balanced static and dynamic feature learning. DISReg consists of a static term that shapes the distribution of the image embedding and encourages slow features, and a dynamic term, which, unlike direct regularization on the embedding, imposes no constraint on the image embedding's shape or distribution and instead only incentivizes that dynamic features be present. By integrating this regularizer into a standard JEPA, we establish our new architecture, MotionJEPA. Latent probing demonstrates that MotionJEPA produces more complete representations than other methods, and our trajectory analysis shows it maintains geometrically simple latent embeddings with low curvature. We further show that MotionJEPA improves downstream planning success under static-background distractors across four environments.
papers.summary_zh: 联合嵌入预测架构（JEPA）是一种无需视觉重建即可学习任务无关潜在世界模型的有前景范式。然而，标准JEPA训练对慢特征存在强归纳偏置，导致特征抑制和潜在表征坍缩。逆动力学虽提供时序抗坍缩能力，但依赖动作标签，且对嵌入通用的无标签动态缺乏激励。本文提出差异图像与单图像嵌入正则化（DISReg），一种基于逆动力学风格模块的新型正则化器，可在无任何像素重建损失的情况下预测时序差异图像嵌入，鼓励静态与动态特征的平衡学习。DISReg包含静态项（塑造图像嵌入分布并鼓励慢特征）和动态项（不同于对嵌入的直接正则化，不对图像嵌入的形状或分布施加约束，仅激励动态特征的存在）。将该正则化器集成到标准JEPA中，构建了新架构MotionJEPA。潜在探测表明MotionJEPA产生比其他方法更完整的表征，轨迹分析显示其保持几何简单、低曲率的潜在嵌入。进一步表明MotionJEPA在四个环境中提升了静态背景干扰下的下游规划成功率。
papers.insight_zh: 该文的时序差异嵌入正则化思路可迁移至遥感变化检测中的双时相特征学习，有助于缓解变化信号被静态背景淹没的问题；但其验证环境为通用视觉任务，向地理空间场景的适用性尚需进一步检验。

papers.title: PosEviLoc: Position-Conditioned Spatial Evidence for Language-Based 3D Localization
papers.title_zh: PosEviLoc：面向基于语言的三维定位的位置条件化空间证据
papers.reason: 该文研究基于语言描述的3D点云子图定位，涉及空间关系建模与地理空间智能中的位置检索，与遥感变化检测和多源数据融合有一定方法关联，但与城市更新和时空数据挖掘的直接联系较弱。
papers.abstract: Language-based 3D localization retrieves the point-cloud submap containing a target position from descriptions of nearby objects and their spatial relations. Existing methods typically compress queries and submaps into global descriptors, potentially obscuring object-level semantics and cross-description spatial coherence. We propose Position-Conditioned Evidence Localization (PosEviLoc), a query-position-aware framework for coarse text-to-point-cloud localization. Instead of relying on global matching, PosEviLoc evaluates each candidate submap using explicit semantic and spatial evidence. It models direction as a relation jointly determined by an object position and a hypothetical query position. The resulting Query-Position Spatial Evidence Field (QSEF) measures the fraction of query descriptions supported at each hypothetical position, explicitly capturing their agreement without using the ground-truth query pose to construct the evidence field. A Multi-Level Evidence Readout (MER) summarizes this evidence in a compact representation, which a lightweight MLP converts into a retrieval score. Across five benchmarks, PosEviLoc outperforms MNCL by an average of 17 percentage points in Recall@1. When used as a plug-and-play reranker, it improves MNCL by an average of 16 percentage points. Moreover, PosEviLoc introduces substantially fewer parameters and achieves faster inference speed than existing methods.
papers.summary_zh: 基于语言的三维定位旨在根据对附近物体及其空间关系的描述，检索包含目标位置的点云子图。现有方法通常将查询和子图压缩为全局描述符，可能掩盖物体级语义和跨描述的空间一致性。本文提出位置条件化证据定位（PosEviLoc），一种面向查询位置感知的粗粒度文本到点云定位框架。PosEviLoc不依赖全局匹配，而是使用显式语义和空间证据评估每个候选子图。它将方向建模为由物体位置和假设查询位置共同决定的关系。由此得到的查询-位置空间证据场（QSEF）衡量每个假设位置支持的查询描述比例，在不使用真实查询位姿构建证据场的情况下显式捕捉其一致性。多级证据读出（MER）将证据总结为紧凑表示，再由轻量MLP转换为检索分数。在五个基准上，PosEviLoc在Recall@1上平均超过MNCL 17个百分点。作为即插即用重排序器时，平均提升MNCL 16个百分点。此外，PosEviLoc参数显著更少，推理速度更快。
papers.insight_zh: 该工作将空间关系显式建模为位置条件化证据，可能为地理空间智能中的语言-位置对齐提供思路，但其应用场景为室内/物体级点云定位，向城市尺度的迁移需进一步验证。

papers.title: ZIL: Zero-shot Image-to-LiDAR Registration
papers.title_zh: ZIL：零样本图像到LiDAR配准
papers.reason: 该文提出零样本图像-LiDAR配准基础模型，属于多源数据融合与跨模态空间对齐方向，与地理空间智能中的多模态数据融合有方法层面的关联，但与城市更新、时空数据挖掘的直接联系较弱。
papers.abstract: Image-to-LiDAR registration estimates the camera pose of an image with respect to a LiDAR point cloud. It has diverse applications in autonomous driving, robot navigation etc. However, state-of-the-art (SOTA) methods still 1) mostly assume same-frame inputs, struggling with the image and point cloud from distant frames; 2) rely on domain-specific training, failing to generalize to unseen scenarios. We propose ZIL, the first foundation model for zero-shot non-synchronized image-to-LiDAR registration. ZIL encodes the input image and point cloud with the Vision and Point Transformers. In addition to regressing the relative pose, ZIL also learns to predict 3D coordinates, which substantially improves the pose accuracy without additional annotations. Interestingly, naive mix-data training cannot enable zero-shot generalization, which requires normalization on both camera intrinsics and the LiDAR vertical-axis origin. Trained on 7 public datasets with 1.4M LiDAR frames, ZIL consistently and significantly outperforms previous SOTA with a single model across 5 in-domain and zero-shot benchmarks, reducing the translation and rotation errors by up to 87% and 76% (shown in Fig. 1). Code and models are available at https://github.com/ZijunLi7/ZIL.
papers.summary_zh: 图像到LiDAR配准旨在估计图像相对于LiDAR点云的相机位姿，在自动驾驶、机器人导航等领域有广泛应用。然而现有最先进方法仍存在两点不足：一是大多假设图像与点云来自同一帧，难以处理远距离帧的输入；二是依赖特定领域训练，无法泛化到未见场景。本文提出ZIL，首个用于零样本非同步图像到LiDAR配准的基础模型。ZIL使用视觉Transformer和点云Transformer分别编码输入图像与点云。除回归相对位姿外，ZIL还学习预测三维坐标，从而在无需额外标注的情况下显著提升位姿精度。有趣的是，简单的混合数据训练无法实现零样本泛化，需要对相机内参和LiDAR垂直轴原点进行归一化。ZIL在7个公开数据集、140万LiDAR帧上训练，以单一模型在5个域内和零样本基准上持续显著超越此前最先进方法，平移和旋转误差最多降低87%和76%。代码与模型已开源。
papers.insight_zh: 该工作表明跨模态配准的零样本泛化依赖于对相机内参与LiDAR垂直轴原点的归一化处理，这一发现对多源地理空间数据融合中的坐标与传感器参数标准化具有方法启示。

papers.title: The Wisdom of Artificial Deliberative Crowds
papers.title_zh: 人工审议式群体的智慧
papers.reason: 该研究探讨大语言模型之间的审议式聚合机制，发现模型多样性是集体增益的关键条件，与研究中LLM和多智能体方向直接相关，但其应用场景（视觉估计、同行评审、恶意行为检测、体育预测）与城市更新或地理空间分析无直接联系。
papers.abstract: The aggregation of many lay estimates often outperforms individual expert judgment, a phenomenon known as the wisdom of crowds. While this is usually attributed to the independence of estimates, an even stronger effect arises through deliberation: averaging the consensus estimates of small deliberating groups outperforms the classical wisdom of crowds, with individual judgments themselves also becoming more accurate after deliberation. Whether these improvements transfer to large language models deliberating amongst themselves is unknown. Here we adapt a three-stage deliberation paradigm previously used with human participants for use with large language models from three different families, and test it across four domains of increasing real-world stakes: visual numerical estimation (Study 1), peer review of machine-learning papers (Study 2), detection of hidden malicious behavior by an artificial intelligence agent (Study 3), and sports forecasting against a real prediction market (Study 4). Across domains, deliberation reduced collective error beyond passive aggregation of independent responses, and post-deliberation individual judgments retained this collective gain. Notably, the advantage required model diversity: groups composed of clones of a single model did not benefit from deliberating. These results establish machine deliberation as a general-purpose aggregation mechanism, and point to diversity as an active ingredient.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究将原本用于人类参与者的三阶段审议范式迁移至三个不同家族的大语言模型，并在四个现实风险递增的领域进行测试：视觉数值估计（研究1）、机器学习论文同行评审（研究2）、检测人工智能代理的隐藏恶意行为（研究3）以及对抗真实预测市场的体育预测（研究4）。结果显示，在所有领域中，审议均比独立回答的被动聚合更能降低集体误差，且审议后的个体判断仍保留了集体增益。值得注意的是，这一优势需要模型多样性：由单一模型克隆组成的群体无法从审议中获益。
papers.insight_zh: 该研究提示，多智能体系统中引入异质性模型可能比同质模型集成更有效，这一发现或可迁移至城市更新场景中多源异构数据或多角色智能体的协同决策框架设计，但需注意其验证领域与地理空间任务存在显著差异。

papers.title: Dissecting Training-Free Uncertainty Estimation in Multimodal Large Language Models
papers.title_zh: 剖析多模态大语言模型中的免训练不确定性估计
papers.reason: 该文系统研究多模态大语言模型的免训练不确定性估计，与LLM及多智能体方向相关，但其核心是模型不确定性而非地理空间智能或城市更新，故相关性中等。
papers.abstract: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have achieved remarkable performance across a wide range of multimodal tasks, yet understanding and quantifying their predictive uncertainty remains underexplored despite being central for safety critical applications. In this work, we present a systematic study of training-free uncertainty quantification strategies for MLLMs, categorizing existing approaches into three conceptual families: token-level methods, which operate directly in the text output space; verbalized methods, which elicit uncertainty estimates or abstention signals via natural language prompts; and semantic methods, which measure uncertainty in a semantic meaning space. We benchmark these strategies across multiple datasets, model families, generations, and scales, and find that no single family dominates: token-level entropy (at sampling temperature 1.0) wins on short answers, verbalized abstention on sentence-length responses, and semantic methods on long-form generation.
papers.summary_zh: 多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）在多种多模态任务上表现优异，但其预测不确定性的理解与量化仍研究不足，而这对于安全关键应用至关重要。本文系统研究MLLMs的免训练不确定性量化策略，将现有方法分为三类：在文本输出空间直接操作的token级方法、通过自然语言提示引出不确定性估计或弃权信号的言语化方法，以及在语义意义空间度量不确定性的语义方法。作者在多个数据集、模型家族、代际和规模上对这些策略进行基准测试，发现没有单一类别占优：token级熵（采样温度1.0）在短答案上胜出，言语化弃权在句子长度回答上胜出，语义方法在长文本生成上胜出。
papers.insight_zh: 该研究提示，在将LLM用于地理空间智能任务时，不确定性估计方法的选择需依输出形式而定，短答案、句子级回答与长文本生成可能适用不同策略，这对构建可靠的地理空间问答或智能体系统具有参考价值。

papers.title: SCoR: A Hierarchical Framework for Forecasting Relations Between Scientific Concepts
papers.title_zh: SCoR：预测科学概念间关系的层次化框架
papers.reason: 该文构建科学概念关系预测的层次化框架，涉及时序图建模与知识演化预测，与时空数据挖掘中的动态图学习、以及LLM辅助科学发现的研究方向有方法层面的关联，但不涉及地理空间数据或城市更新应用。
papers.abstract: Anticipating emerging research directions is a critical goal of AI-assisted science. Existing methods mainly predict which concepts will co-occur in future papers, but co-occurrence captures shared attention rather than the scientific meaning of a connection, such as whether one method uses, combines, replaces, or contradicts another. We formulate research-direction discovery as hierarchical scientific-relation forecasting over a shared candidate-pair space, comprising three temporally aligned tasks: first co-occurrence, first scientific-relation formation, and relation type at formation. We construct SCoR-Graph from 187,848 cs.CV papers published between 2017 and 2026, yielding 270,687 consolidated concepts, 7.45 million co-occurrence edges, and 615,036 typed, directed relation edges. From cutoff-specific graph snapshots, we derive SCoR-Bench, a leakage-audited benchmark for these three capabilities, with expert-verified gold labels for the entire relation-type test set. We further introduce HiSCoR, a task-adapted model family that models relation emergence as a temporally evolving, hierarchically constrained process by encoding pre-cutoff event histories and conditioning relation formation on future co-occurrence. On the held-out 2025-2026 window, HiSCoR achieves an AUROC of 0.9515, a 2.4% relative improvement over the strongest temporal-graph baseline, and improves population-AUPRC by 14.0%; its relation-type variant achieves a Macro-AUROC of 0.7795. Ablations show that semantic, co-occurrence, and typed-relation views provide complementary predictive evidence. SCoR advances research-direction forecasting from predicting which concepts will co-occur to anticipating whether and how evidence-backed scientific relations will emerge.
papers.summary_zh: 该文将研究方向发现重新表述为共享候选对空间上的层次化科学关系预测，包含三个时间对齐任务：首次共现、首次科学关系形成以及形成时的关系类型。作者基于2017至2026年间187,848篇cs.CV论文构建了SCoR-Graph，包含270,687个整合概念、745万条共现边和615,036条带类型的有向关系边，并由此派生出去泄漏审计的基准SCoR-Bench，其关系类型测试集全部由专家验证。作者进一步提出HiSCoR模型族，将关系涌现建模为时间演化且受层次约束的过程，通过编码截断前事件历史并以未来共现为条件来预测关系形成。在2025-2026留出窗口上，HiSCoR取得0.9515的AUROC，较最强时序图基线相对提升2.4%，population-AUPRC提升14.0%；关系类型变体取得0.7795的Macro-AUROC。消融实验表明语义、共现和类型化关系三种视图提供互补的预测证据。
papers.insight_zh: 该工作把研究前沿预测从“哪些概念会共现”推进到“是否以及如何形成有证据支撑的科学关系”，其层次化时序图建模思路可迁移到城市更新中多主体、多类型事件关系的演化预测，但论文本身未涉及地理空间场景。

papers.title: SolarFlowRefiner: Refinement-Aware Flow Matching for Surface Solar Radiation Downscaling
papers.title_zh: SolarFlowRefiner：面向地表太阳辐射降尺度的细化感知流匹配方法
papers.reason: 该论文研究多源降尺度任务，将粗分辨率ERA5再分析辐射变量与配准卫星通道融合，重建高分辨率地表太阳辐射场，属于遥感与多源地理空间数据融合范畴，与研究方向中的遥感变化检测和多源数据融合有一定关联，但不涉及城市更新、时空数据挖掘或LLM多智能体。
papers.abstract: High-resolution surface solar radiation (SSR) is important for solar forecasting and grid operation. However, physically consistent reanalysis products are too coarse to resolve localized cloud-driven variability. In this paper, we study a multisource downscaling task that reconstructs high-resolution SolarCube SSR fields from coarse ERA5 radiative variables and co-registered satellite channels. The task is challenging because a single ERA5 grid cell may contain both sunlit and cloud-shadowed regions. As a result, the missing high-resolution correction can be spatially sharp and inherently ambiguous. One-stage predictors often oversmooth these structures. Post-hoc refinement also introduces a stage-wise mismatch: the generator is optimized independently, even though its output determines the refiner's initial state. We introduce SolarFlowRefiner, a refinement-aware flow-matching framework for SSR downscaling. A conditional FlowMatch generator first predicts a normalized correction to an upsampled ERA5 baseline. The refiner is then trained on prediction-conditioned states between the current FlowMatch output and the target residual. This exposes the refiner to the structured errors produced by the generator. The refinement objective is also backpropagated through the FlowMatch sampler, allowing generation and correction to be jointly optimized for the final reconstruction. Experiments on a day-blocked ERA5--SolarCube benchmark show consistent improvements over standalone generation and post-hoc refinement. More broadly, SolarFlowRefiner provides a general strategy for coupling generative predictors with iterative correctors.
papers.summary_zh: 高分辨率地表太阳辐射（SSR）对太阳能预报和电网运行十分重要，但物理一致的再分析产品分辨率过粗，难以刻画局地云致变化。本文研究一项多源降尺度任务：从粗分辨率ERA5辐射变量和配准卫星通道重建高分辨率SolarCube SSR场。该任务的难点在于单个ERA5网格单元可能同时包含日照区和云影区，因此缺失的高分辨率订正可能空间上十分尖锐且本质模糊，单阶段预测器往往过度平滑这些结构；事后细化还会引入阶段间失配，因为生成器独立优化，而其输出却决定细化器的初始状态。作者提出SolarFlowRefiner，一种细化感知的流匹配框架：条件FlowMatch生成器先预测对上采样ERA5基线的归一化订正，细化器则在当前FlowMatch输出与目标残差之间的预测条件状态上训练，从而暴露于生成器产生的结构化误差；细化目标还通过FlowMatch采样器反向传播，使生成与订正联合优化以服务于最终重建。在按天分块的ERA5–SolarCube基准上，该方法相较独立生成和事后细化均取得一致提升。更广泛地，SolarFlowRefiner为耦合生成式预测器与迭代校正器提供了通用策略。
papers.insight_zh: 该工作提示，在多源遥感降尺度中，将生成式预测器与迭代校正器联合优化、并让校正器暴露于生成器的结构化误差，可能缓解单阶段过度平滑问题；这一思路或可迁移到其他高分辨率地理空间场重建任务，但其有效性仍需在更多数据集上验证。

papers.title: Resist, Update, Reject: Preference Optimization Installs a Prior-Dependent Reliability Switch
papers.title_zh: 抵抗、更新、拒绝：偏好优化安装了一个依赖先验的可靠性开关
papers.reason: 该文研究LLM在来源可靠性下的抵抗、更新与拒绝行为，属于LLM与多智能体研究范畴，与研究者关注的LLM和多智能体方向相关，但与城市更新、时空数据挖掘、遥感变化检测等核心GIS主题关联较弱。
papers.abstract: An aligned model asked to hold its answer against a manipulative source must still update on a reliable one and reject an unreliable one: resistance, reliable-update, and unreliable-source rejection are one three-way contract, not three independent behaviors. We show the objective most anti-sycophancy work optimizes is non-identifying with respect to source reliability: because no preference label depends on whether a source is actually reliable, any scalar mixture of the arms traces a single deference dial, and no point separates two same-template testimonies differing only in stated reliability. This fixation$\leftrightarrow$gullibility frontier is a property of the objective, not any model. We make reliability identifiable through data: a threshold benchmark where a source asserts the opposite answer while stating its reliability $r$, and the correct action is to flip iff $r$ exceeds the model's prior strength $p$. Preference optimization over balanced coverage installs a prior-dependent reliability switch: across three seeds on Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct the threshold $r^\star$ rises monotonically with the prior, decision accuracy reaches $0.84$ with a monotone flip curve (Spearman $0.56$), and the policy generalizes to unseen reliability values and a held-out notation, following stated reliability over role prestige. Three controls localize the cause: an unmatched variant installs the switch equally ($0.80$), a second preference optimizer (IPO) installs it just as well ($0.86$), whereas supervised imitation does not ($0.50$), so the cause is preference optimization over reliability-labeled coverage, not pairing, loss, or imitation. A confirmatory battery replicates the switch on a fresh test draw, bounds it honestly (it keys on reliability stated in the testimony, not a separately audited record), and transfers it to Llama-3.1-8B. The frontier is empirical, not a theorem.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究指出，对齐模型在面对操纵性来源时需同时满足抵抗、可靠更新与不可靠来源拒绝这一三方契约，而非三种独立行为。作者证明多数反谄媚工作优化的目标对来源可靠性不可识别，因为偏好标签不依赖于来源是否真实可靠，任何标量混合都只能追踪单一的顺从刻度。为此，作者通过数据使可靠性可识别：构建阈值基准，来源在声明其可靠性r的同时断言相反答案，正确行为是当且仅当r超过模型先验强度p时翻转。在Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct上跨三个随机种子，偏好优化在平衡覆盖下安装了一个依赖先验的可靠性开关，阈值r*随先验单调上升，决策准确率达0.84，翻转曲线单调（Spearman 0.56），策略可泛化到未见可靠性值与留出符号，并遵循声明的可靠性而非角色声望。三项控制实验定位了原因：非匹配变体同样安装开关（0.80），另一偏好优化器IPO同样有效（0.86），而监督模仿则无效（0.50），说明原因是基于可靠性标注覆盖的偏好优化，而非配对、损失或模仿。
papers.insight_zh: 该工作提示，在涉及多源信息融合与智能体决策的场景中，模型对来源可靠性的处理可能受偏好优化目标的结构性限制，需通过显式可靠性标注数据来建立可识别的可靠性判断机制。
